svg.title: 当前默认对SYCL：Code decode +40.78–41.01%，Prose +49.12–49.31%；同机跨测量组速率参考
svg.desc: Same A77016GB/Xeon E5-2696v4/256GiB DDR3/Windows10. Current default measured2026-11-08 versus corrected SYCL native FP16 paired-M4 measured2026-11-04;2048 input/128 output,128000/decode_ms. SYCL durations are geometric means of native controls0/3 in the frozen native/U4/U2/native cohort; current durations come from the independent forward/reverse HC256/default comparisons. Bars use the first current summary;labels span its two orders,not confidence intervals. This is a cross-cohort configuration/rate reference,not a concurrent SYCL/default/SYCL bracket, not a pure API speedup and not proof of output/quality equivalence between versions. SYCL has5771slots/spec4;current has6509slots/spec6/confidence0.6/layer-profile/HC SG16. Current42requests/4704outputs pass full8-field references,6exit codes0. Full request includes prefill and excludes HTTP/startup. Separate original-mainline history uses SYCL2026-10-21;do not multiply ratios.
